preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdin.split()[1:2*n+1])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000). The second and third lines each contain exactly n integers between 1 and n inclusive, representing permutations p and s respectively.
All elements in the combined list of p and s are distinct and cover the range 1 to n exactly once (i.e., they are valid permutations).
The input consists of exactly three lines: n, p, and s.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total coins required to transform p into s.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1]) and int(stdout.split()[1]) >= 0
postconditions.description: The second line of stdout is a non-negative integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ 2·10^6), representing the number of swap operations.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == 2 + int(stdout.split()[1]) and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.split()[2:])
postconditions.description: The remaining k lines of stdout each contain two integers i and j (1 ≤ i, j ≤ n, i ≠ j), representing valid swap operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(i) <= n and 1 <= int(j) <= n and int(i) != int(j) for line in stdout.split()[2:] for i, j in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: Each swap operation (i, j) is valid, meaning i and j are distinct indices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[0]) >= sum(abs(int(i) - int(j)) for line in stdout.split()[2:] for i, j in [line.split()]))
postconditions.description: The total coins paid (sum of |i-j| for all swaps) does not exceed the minimum coins printed in the first line of stdout.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.split()[2:])
postconditions.description: All indices in swap operations are within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: any(all(int(stdout.split()[0]) == sum(abs(int(i) - int(j)) for line in stdout.split()[2:] for i, j in [line.split()]) and len(stdout.split()) == 2 + int(stdout.split()[1]))
postconditions.description: The total coins paid by the sequence of swaps exactly matches the minimum coins printed in the first line of stdout.
